        .groupby('Loan ID')
        .last()
        .reset_index()
    )

    total_balance = latest_snap['Outstanding Principal'].sum()

    delinq_30 = latest_snap[latest_snap['Days Past Due'] >= 30]

    by_product_total = latest_snap.groupby('Product')['Outstanding Principal'].sum()
